> Firmographic / technographic / behavioural segmentation — the profession's standard decomposition of a profile, with need and economic fit as the commercial overlay.
 It exists mainly to stop teams stopping at the first block. Naming the three forces the question "what do we know about how they buy", which is where the predictive power sits and which a firmographic-only exercise never reaches.
